reply_text:
I saved Tobias's note to memory: his standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team for the Tamarack rollout is Thursdays at 9:30. I added it to the memory index and marked it as something to bring up only in his own DMs. I kept it apart from the existing note about Pree's Marrow call, since that one comes from Pree's DMs.

I replied to him in his DM to confirm I'd noted it. Since he said no action was needed, I didn't put anything on the calendar.
